policy: A capability is CONNECTED only when its local implementation or configured external dependency is actually usable. Research references never grant authority by themselves.

enablers.name: Termux python-torch
enablers.fact: The official Termux package repository contains python-torch for PyTorch on Termux.

enablers.name: LangGraph.js
enablers.fact: LangGraph.js is installable with @langchain/langgraph and @langchain/core and supports controllable stateful agent workflows.

enablers.name: Stripe Billing API
enablers.fact: Stripe exposes GET /v1/subscriptions for live subscription reads.

enablers.name: Oxford Dictionaries API
enablers.fact: Oxford Dictionaries API v2 accepts app_id/app_key headers and provides dictionary/lexical endpoints; sandbox credentials are available through Oxford.
enablers.activation: export OXFORD_APP_ID='...'; export OXFORD_APP_KEY='...'; npm run capabilities:probe

enablers.name: OctoPrint REST API
enablers.fact: OctoPrint provides authenticated REST endpoints for printer connection, files and print-job operations.
enablers.activation: export OCTOPRINT_URL='http://printer:5000'; export OCTOPRINT_API_KEY='...'; export FABRICATION_ENABLE=1; npm run capabilities:probe
